# Effect: tape

Tape: warm tape-saturation distortion plus unsteady transport pitch wobble (wow / flutter).

**Where to put it**: For lo-fi, vintage and warmth: use lightly on a whole bus or the master bus (drive 3-6), heavier on a single track. wow_cents 5-15 gives the off-pitch feel of an old cassette.

Latest parameters: `muser effects tape` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `drive_db` | 6 | 0 – 30 dB | Drive. 3-6 warm; above 12 obviously distorted |
| `asymmetry` | 0.15 | 0 – 0.5 | Asymmetry, adds even harmonics (warmer) |
| `wow_cents` | 3 | 0 – 30 cent | Depth of the slow pitch wobble. 0 = off; 5-15 old cassette |
| `flutter_cents` | 1 | 0 – 10 cent | Depth of the fast pitch flutter |
| `mix` | 1 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "tape", "drive_db": 5, "wow_cents": 8 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Warm (master bus, drum bus)

  ```json
  {"type": "tape", "drive_db": 4, "wow_cents": 0, "flutter_cents": 0}
  ```

- Old cassette lo-fi (out-of-tune feel)

  ```json
  {"type": "tape", "drive_db": 6, "wow_cents": 12, "flutter_cents": 3}
  ```

- Heavy saturation

  ```json
  {"type": "tape", "drive_db": 15, "asymmetry": 0.3, "mix": 0.8}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- wow / flutter make the pitch waver slightly: most obvious on chordal instruments and piano; set them to 0 when you only want warmth.
- Lo-fi chain: tape -> bitcrusher (light) -> eq lowpass 8000 -> reverb.
- drive makes the sound louder; use `muser mix-report` to see the post-fader loudness, then adjust gain_db.
